### FU-2026-10-02-009 — Host half di SiteShellContract nel mirror engine
- State: done
- Target repository: valerielinc-ops/frontaliere-si-o-no
- Target file: build-plugins/articlesSiteShellBootstrap.ts
- Source: PR #2038 / PR body `## Non implementato (ancora)`
- Stato dichiarato nella PR: blocked: the boundary between the two repos.
- Original text:
  > blocked: the boundary between the two repos. The `host/` half of `SiteShellContract` cannot travel with this PR — the fail-closed allowlist on the staged diff refuses every path outside `engine/`, `index.ts` and `articleSections.ts`, and `host/` lives in the site repo. If the diff above touches `engine/siteShell.ts`, its `host/` counterpart has to be shipped by hand in the same round from the site repo, or the engine raises `TypeError: <member> is not a function` at render time behind a green CI — `tests/packages-articles-confinement.test.ts` proves imports, and the contract has no import shape for it to see.
- Funnel impact: contratto col sito / superficie pubblicata
- Rationale: la metà host alimenta il `SiteShellContract` letto dall engine; una divergenza tra le due metà può rompere il render a runtime dietro una CI verde.
- Blocked on: allowlist del mirror engine e consegna coordinata della metà host nel repository del sito.
- Acceptance token: `configureSiteShell(contract)`
- Sources: PR #2038
- Suggested action: spedire e verificare il bootstrap host del sito in `build-plugins/articlesSiteShellBootstrap.ts`, mantenendo `configureSiteShell(contract)` coordinato con il mirror engine.
